changelog: v0.5.1: 1) Agent Tool & Skill Execution Engine with browser sensing and 3D scene control; 2) Real-time live context grounding (time, date, battery, system specs, memory heap); 3) Scene & avatar voice commands ('change space to garden/cafe/penthouse/passthrough', 'switch avatar to maya/alex/ollie'); 4) Full dual support for Local LLM (zero-latency deterministic execution & action tag parsing) and Cloud Gemini (native function declarations & tool calling); 5) In-HUD diagnostic logging for all tool executions.
